meta.name: ci-pipeline-synthesizer
meta.description: Generate GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline configurations for automated building and testing of library and package projects. Use when creating or updating CI workflows for npm packages, Python packages, Go modules, Rust crates, or other library projects that need automated build and test pipelines. Includes templates for common package ecosystems with best practices for dependency caching, matrix testing, and artifact publishing.

copy.tagline: 自动生成库项目的 CI/CD 流水线配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为 npm、Python、Go 或 Rust 库项目配置自动化构建和测试。
